summary: Reclamation-direct-managed recreation land on Belle Fourche Reservoir (RMP map 2024): two dispersed areas, Middle Point and the Susie Pk Rd peninsula out to Gadens Point. Lakefront kept: on Esri imagery (water at the grass line) short spurs off the Middle Point loop end at pull-offs on open prairie 10-30 m from the water. No current Reclamation rules page readable (usbr.gov resets; 2019 RMP newsletter proposed designated sites + self-registration). Stored website is GFP Rocky Point's rec.gov gateway; pin ~420 m W of the Middle Point pull-offs.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - KEPT): Esri World Imagery (vintage not stated; reservoir at the vegetation line, i.e. near full pool) shows the Middle Point loop road with short spurs to gravel pull-offs along the peninsula's south shore and tip, ~44.7283-44.7292, -103.7205 to -103.7150, each 10-30 m from the water over open prairie, a camper parked at one; the Susie Pk Rd peninsula's south shore (~44.738,-103.712) shows campers at the waterline too. No trees or riprap between. Dispersed pull-offs, not numbered sites. Belle Fourche is an irrigation reservoir that draws down through the summer; the 2019 RMP newsletter: 'In the past, campers have followed the water and camped on the exposed shorelines as the Reservoir water levels recede throughout the summer ... No shoreline driving or camping' - so late-season water can be well below these pull-offs.

RULES CHANGE (unread): the 2019 Reclamation RMP newsletter proposed 'Camper self-registration stations will be installed on Reclamation direct-managed areas' and 'all campers will be required to camp in a designated campsite' (2020 RMP; map updated 2024). Whether designated sites, a registration fee or a camp host now exist could not be read (usbr.gov resets the connection; the RMP PDF is not archived). Stored fees $0 (derived) and FCFS left as is; recommend a call to Reclamation's Dakotas Area Office before relying on 'free'.
